_doc: Phase 51 T2 — blind semantic-equivalence judgments over a deterministic sample of cross-regulator co-occurring indicator pairs. SINGLE-RATER, ILLUSTRATIVE. Consensus (>=2 independent raters) is deferred-with-owner. Regenerate the exact pairs with: python3 scripts/corpus_redundancy.py --sample 24 --seed 0. NON-SHIP measurement data; build.py never reads data/corpus-redundancy/. NO de-dup or similarity claim is made on any ship artifact.
label: single-rater illustrative; verdict = does the same underlying behaviour a monitoring rule would target get described (equivalent / partial = related-but-a-rule-for-one-misses-the-other / distinct); consensus-class never ground truth
